rendererEnvelope.sessionId: Controller-supplied opaque random nonempty string, at most 256 characters; never reuse within an owner generation. This identifier alone is not transport authentication.
rendererEnvelope.generation: Nonnegative safe integer identifying the controller owner.
rendererEnvelope.ready: Usable content is rendered; visible and focused must both be true before ownership is granted.

policy.clock: Caller-supplied monotonic milliseconds, never renderer wall-clock timestamps.
policy.activation: PREVIEW, ELIGIBLE and GLOBAL require supplied sessionId and matching generation. PREVIEW requires previewEligible; ELIGIBLE requires inAppEligible, prior ACTIVITY and elapsed idleTimeoutMs. Missing flags deny startup. GLOBAL is issued only by the edition owner following a natural LG request and requires globalEligible.
policy.rendererEvents: READY and HEARTBEAT require the complete schema-1 envelope. CLOSE, CLOSED and FOCUS_LOST require matching sessionId and generation. ACTIVITY and DEADLINE may be controller-wide; any supplied identity must match.
policy.timeouts: Positive finite context values override defaults. Controllers must schedule DEADLINE calls independently of renderer messages.
policy.lg: LG_REQUEST only evaluates an already visible session. The LG adapter may request GLOBAL separately with a bounded readiness wait. RESPOND_LG preserves event.request unchanged; allow=false only while healthy, visible, focused and heartbeat-fresh. Adapter validates requests, deduplicates them, echoes timestamp without coercion, and unregisters on stop.
policy.ownership: CLOSE and RELEASE refer only to our supplied session. RELEASE is idempotent adapter cleanup, never a third-party launch or playback operation. OWNER_STOP releases immediately. Other closes await CLOSED or bounded close timeout. After dismissal, automatic launch requires fresh ACTIVITY and a new idle period.
policy.transport: Adapters authenticate envelopes independently; session identity checks do not replace authentication. Never expose an unauthenticated control endpoint.
